Technology Enabling Centre (TEC) – Panjab University, Chandigarh
ADVERTISEMENT
Applications are invited for the following temporary posts under DST project “Technology Enabling Centre
(TEC). The posts will be initially filled up for one year but can be further extended depending on the
performance and work capabilities of the selected candidates.

Job Profile
Desired Skills / Abilities
 Strong administrative and organizational skills
 Strong communication skills over phone
 Fully IT literate including use of Microsoft Office applications, Email drafting etc.
 Able to work effectively with minimum supervision
 Able to work under pressure at times
Other Requirements
 Fully flexible and able to work during evening and weekend (if the need arises)
Working Days: Monday to Saturday
Duties and Key Responsibilities
Manager (Finance)
 Handling Finance
 All paperwork corresponding to consultancy projects, CSR projects, Transfer of
Technology(ToT), IPR cases etc.
 Preparing contingent bills corresponding to projects and getting them audited
Technology Enabling Centre (TEC) – Panjab University, Chandigarh
Recruitment Process
Application along with the following documents (in the order given below) in a single envelope should
reach at “Ist Floor Guru Tegh Bahadur Bhawan Buidling, Opposite USOL Sector 14, Chandigarh, U.T. –
160014” by speed post / registered post before 5th May, 2023. Envelope should be titled “Application for
the post of Manager Finance”. Any application reached after 5th May, 2023 will not be entertained.
1. Application Form given in Annexure I; filled by hand with blue colour (not by typing) and ink-sign
in the places specified. Do not insert a scanned signature.
2. CV
3. Personal statement (maximum 500 words) on why you think you are suitable for the position
4. Attested copies of certificates of (i) Class X (ii) Class XII / Diploma (iii) Degree(s) (iv) Experience
certificates supporting details mentioned in the application form/CV/personal statement (v)
Government issued Photo ID proof (Aadhaar card/ passport/ DL) (vi) Date of Birth Proof (vii) Any
other document supporting your application
5. Written and signed explanation for any missing documents
Candidates found to be potentially suitable will be informed via email to appear in next step of selection
process (written test / personal interview / practical test). Those appearing for the interview should come
with original of the application file and all documents submitted by email; and also one attested photocopy
of the same.
Prof. Manu Sharma
Coordinator TEC,
CIIPP Office, Panjab University,
Sector 14, Chandigarh.
